# MorrowTab

> MorrowTab is a Chrome and Edge extension that replaces the new-tab page with a board-based homepage: organized links, read-only calendar boards, a search box that uses the browser's default provider or extra engines the user adds, and a daily FixQuotes quote. Browser Sync is the default and needs no MorrowTab account. Users can explicitly connect an email-based FixQuotes Sync account for a larger budget and Chrome-to-Edge syncing; this stores a server-readable board replica with FixQuotes. On Zoom recording pages, MorrowTab can show direct recording files in a local download overlay.

MorrowTab is published by FixQuotes and is available from Microsoft Edge Add-ons: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/pbdbhkiajaobdacbebifndnghiiodlgi. It is also available from the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/gfpandbngbmageefohholgefhmhahpff. Requirements are Chrome or Edge on Chromium 114 or newer.

Use the user manual for detailed information about boards, calendar boards, columns and links, search engines and URL templates, the Quick Save toolbar popup, keyboard shortcuts, themes and backgrounds, the four daily-quote modes, backup and restore, the enforced storage limits, and the read-only recovery view.

## Key facts

- Platform: MorrowTab is a Manifest V3 extension for Chrome and Edge.
- Browsers: Chrome or Edge on Chromium 114 or newer. The floor exists because MorrowTab uses the Popover API, Web Locks, CSS `:has()` and CSS `color-mix()`. There is no Firefox, Safari or mobile version.
- Availability: as of 7 September 2026 MorrowTab is published on Microsoft Edge Add-ons at https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/pbdbhkiajaobdacbebifndnghiiodlgi. It is also published on the Chrome Web Store at https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/gfpandbngbmageefohholgefhmhahpff. This site offers no direct download or side-load instructions, and there is no public source repository.
- Sync choices and accounts: Browser Sync is the default. It writes the board graph to `chrome.storage.sync` under the browser profile and requires no MorrowTab account; FixQuotes receives no board copy in this mode. FixQuotes Sync is optional. Requesting a code sends a normalized email address to FixQuotes and Mailgun, and successful verification creates an account and 30-day device session. No board data is uploaded until the user reviews the disclosure and selects Connect. The user can choose an existing FixQuotes copy or merge it with the current computer. Each computer signs in separately, allowing Chrome and Edge to use the same account.
- FixQuotes Sync data: after explicit connection, FixQuotes stores the account email, random account ID, board replica, revision/update time, protected authentication records and temporary rate-limit records. The replica includes board and column names, saved URL titles/addresses/descriptions, click counts, search-engine definitions, shared settings, private calendar-feed addresses, pseudonymous actor/causal metadata and retained conflict/deletion history. HTTPS protects transfer, but the service is not end-to-end encrypted and authorized server operators can read the board replica. Uploaded backgrounds, saved search suggestions, downloaded calendar events and cached images are not uploaded. Sign-out revokes that device session when reachable and retains its local working copy; signing out or uninstalling does not delete the server account. Account-deletion requests go through the MorrowTab FixQuotes support form and require fresh verification through the account email.
- Calendar boards: a board can be created as a Calendar board instead of a Links board. It shows a read-only two-week agenda built from up to ten subscribed iCalendar feeds — Google Calendar's "Secret address in iCal format" and Outlook's "Publish a calendar" ICS link — each with a name and an accent color. Feed addresses sync with the board and are read capabilities, so the manual tells users to treat them like passwords. Events are downloaded from the new-tab page without cookies or referrer, cached per computer, refreshed after 30 minutes (5 after a failure), on render, once a minute while visible and on Refresh; nothing is ever written back to a calendar, and the providers regenerate private feeds only every few hours. The board offers Agenda, Week and Month layouts with paging, and each calendar's chip hides or shows it; both choices are stored per computer.
- Network services and page access: `https://fixquotes.com` supplies the daily quote; `https://api.fixquotes.com` provides optional FixQuotes Sync, daily nature-background metadata and website-icon lookup; and `https://images.pexels.com` supplies photo bytes. Beyond those service destinations, MorrowTab contacts only a page-title or calendar-feed address the user adds and approves one origin at a time. The daily quote is ON by default (Text mode) and fetches once per local day; setting it to Off stops that request. Nature photos are enabled by `backgroundMode: "pexels"` only in the bundled fresh starter, including its read-only preview. Turning nature off stops background requests but does not change icon downloads. "Fetch page titles when adding links" is off by default and also requires Chrome's permission prompt for the individual origin. A content script runs automatically only at `https://*.zoom.us/rec/*`; it reads the page title and up to 20 direct HTTPS video sources to render a download overlay inside the Zoom page. It does not save or sync those values or send them to FixQuotes. The user must already be able to load the recording page; the overlay does not check Zoom's owner-controlled Download setting and handles only direct video sources exposed in the loaded page, not streaming-only media.
- Website icons: "Download website icons" defaults to ON locally. A working bundled brand needs no request; otherwise MorrowTab can POST only the exact hostname (including subdomain/www) to `https://api.fixquotes.com/public/morrowtab/favicon` as JSON, with no saved path, query, title, credentials, cookies or referrer. FixQuotes obtains public-site artwork directly and returns a verified 32×32 PNG, without a third-party favicon provider. Native generic-globe success does not block lookup. The local cache is limited to 128 entries/256 KiB, seven-day freshness, a 30-day stale-use limit, and 24-hour caching for explicit no-icon/blocked results. Transport failures begin with a five-minute retry delay, exponential backoff capped at 24 hours, and a shared cooldown. Switching downloads off stops new requests and keeps cached icons. Private literals and obvious internal/reserved names are rejected, but public-looking intranet hostnames cannot reliably be identified; disable before showing sensitive internal links if hostname disclosure to FixQuotes is unsuitable. Fixed POST routing keeps the hostname out of application request URLs, not necessarily infrastructure/body logs.
- Permissions declared: contextMenus, storage, favicon, search, activeTab and alarms; optional webNavigation for link auto-close; fixed host permissions for the three services above; a Zoom recording-page content-script match; and an optional `https://*/*` host permission that is never granted at install and is requested one origin at a time for page-title fetching or a subscribed calendar feed.
- Auto-close permission is per installation, while configured link timeouts sync. Saving an enabled timeout or first opening a synced timed link can offer the missing optional navigation permission from that user action. Declining while opening still opens a normal tab without auto-close and without an error warning. A local Boolean remembers the first offer, avoiding repeated automatic prompts across new tabs and reloads. The neutral "Enable auto-close" notice action explicitly retries for future timed openings; Open all shares one pending request. Already-granted access does not prompt, and declining editor Save leaves the link unchanged.
- Storage limits (enforced before every write, nothing is unlimited): both providers allow 30 boards; 120 columns total and 40 per board; 200 links per column; 80 additional search engines total and 20 per board. Browser Sync allows 250 links total, 500 transport records, 8,000 bytes per transport record and 100,000 bytes total. FixQuotes Sync allows 5,000 links total and 4 MiB of serialized replica data. Text caps remain: board name 80 characters, column title 100, link title 160, link description 200, search-engine name 80, and 2,048 characters for a URL or search template.
- Device-local data: the selected board, Quick Save destination, saved search suggestions and their on/off preference, uploaded background, cached nature photo and quote, safety snapshots, managed-tab marker, auto-close prompt marker, favicon cache and its preference, downloaded calendar cache/events, and calendar view choices stay in local extension storage. The extension origin also keeps `morrowtab.appearance` in web `localStorage`, containing the last rendered appearance values and document title for paint-before-load; the title can include the visible board name. Live managed-tab IDs, hostnames and countdowns remain session-only. After FixQuotes connection, that computer also retains the durable cloud working copy, pending-change state, device-session token and a pre-cloud recovery copy locally; the working board replica is separately synced to the FixQuotes server. Credentials never enter Browser Sync or JSON exports.
- Backup: Settings exports the active logical board records to a plaintext JSON file on that computer. It excludes device tokens, raw provider/causal metadata and device-local caches. Importing a full backup replaces all current board data after confirmation; importing a single exported column adds it to the current board instead.
- Search: "Browser default" hands the query to the provider the Chrome or Edge profile is already set to. MorrowTab never changes the browser's default engine and ships with no search provider preconfigured. Search suggestions come only from the user's own completed searches, stored on that computer.
- No analytics, telemetry or tracking script exists in the extension, and this website has no analytics and no consent banner.
- The first-install welcome asks new users to start with the 50-link "Popular websites" sample board or returning users to wait for Browser Sync without publishing the sample. The required empty-state chooser can also import a backup or sign in to an existing FixQuotes Sync account. Empty Browser Sync is otherwise a read-only preview until the user explicitly chooses a source.
- "Boardmark" is not a product name. It survives only as an import alias for files exported before the rename.
